description: The Claude Code adapter's binding of capability classes to harness model references. The Agent tool's `model` field and each agent file's `model:` accept a tier alias (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) or a full model id. A class bound to an ALIAS is exported by the broker launcher under the matching ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL variable, so one alias can carry one model per launch. A class bound by DECLARED full id is named in its agent file and rides no export — which is how the review class stays separate from code-high on the broker path, where both would otherwise share the opus alias. Harness-specific by nature; nothing outside runtime/ reads this file.
